annotation_source: GitHub Copilot source inspection, 2026-10-01; requires human confirmation. Not the evaluator's private labels.
sampling: Five calls selected before reading: 020, 040, 080, 100, 140. Failures were then used for regression development; these five are no longer untouched holdout.

cases.reason: Android crash after update is already tracked. Holding updates is a follow-up, not a second new bug.
Repeatable logout after iOS update matches PROJ-160; no queue output is a true miss, not vague dissatisfaction.
Explicit per-department invoice split requires product work; distinguish from a support-only billing question and shipped CSV workaround.
Existing personal notes disappear after reactivation; manual restoration is a workaround, not an independent Feature.
Hypothetical breakage explicitly denies a defect. Store-level filtering already exists; enablement does not require a ticket.
